==English==

===Etymology===
{{onomatopoeic|en}}.

===Pronunciation===
{{listen|Mudchute cow 1.ogg|the sound of a cow's '''moo'''}}
* {{IPA|en|/muː/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-moo.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|uː|s=1}}
* {{homophones|en|moue}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{lb|en|onomatopoeia}} The characteristic [[low#Etymology 3|lowing]] sound made by [[cattle]].
# {{lb|en|UK|slang|mildly|_|derogatory}} A [[foolish]] [[woman]].
#: {{ux|en|You silly '''moo'''! What did you do that for?}}
#* {{RQ:Mitchell Cloud Atlas|passage='Aurora House does not expel,' said the sanctimonious '''moo''', 'but you will be medicated, if your behaviour warrants it, for your own protection.'}}
